log_sources.title: Proxy and Secure Web Gateway Logs

analytics.name: Analytic 0298
analytics.guidance: Correlation of inbound emails with embedded links followed by user-driven browser navigation to suspicious or obfuscated domains. Detection chain includes malicious URL in email → user click recorded in Office logs → browser process spawning unusual child processes (e.g., PowerShell, cmd) or download activity.

tuning.description: List of monitored top-level domains commonly abused in phishing (e.g., .xyz, .top, .tk).
Domains like bit.ly, tinyurl.com flagged for deeper expansion/inspection.
Time threshold between URL click and suspicious process execution.

log_sources.name: m365:unified
log_sources.channel: Send/Receive: Inbound emails containing embedded or shortened URLs

analytics.name: Analytic 0299
analytics.guidance: Detection of spearphishing links through mail logs and browser activity. Behavior includes email with suspicious URLs → user click recorded in mail/web proxy logs → shell or interpreter launched from browser process.

tuning.description: List of browser processes to monitor (e.g., firefox, chrome, chromium).
Custom regex patterns for detecting obfuscated or IDN homograph URLs.

log_sources.name: Application:Mail
log_sources.channel: Inbound emails containing hyperlinks from suspicious sources

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: execve: Execution of scripts or binaries spawned from browser processes

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: Outbound requests to domains not previously resolved or associated with phishing campaigns

analytics.name: Analytic 0300
analytics.guidance: Correlation of Mail.app logs with Safari/Chrome activity. Suspicious behavior includes email links → Safari/Chrome accessing newly registered or lookalike domains → osascript or Terminal spawned unexpectedly.

tuning.description: Flag self-signed or mismatched TLS certificates from spearphishing domains.
Suspicious delay between URL click and malicious process spawn.

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Received messages with embedded or shortened URLs

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Browser processes launching unexpected interpreters (osascript, bash)

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Connections to suspicious domains with mismatched certificate or unusual patterns

analytics.name: Analytic 0301
analytics.guidance: Detection of OAuth consent phishing or malicious login attempts initiated through spearphishing links. Behavior chain includes inbound email with OAuth URL → consent page visited → unusual token grants logged in IdP logs.

tuning.description: Whitelisted apps permitted for OAuth consent grants.
Patterns of consent from unusual geographies, devices, or unapproved applications.

log_sources.name: azure:signinlogs
log_sources.channel: ConsentGrant: Suspicious consent grants to non-approved or unknown applications
